info.name: UiPath Automation Hub Alerts Groups API

params.name: organizationName
params.description: The name of the UiPath organization

params.name: partitionGlobalId
params.description: Global partition identifier for the organization or tenant scope

items.docs: Retrieves all user groups within the specified organizational partition (tenant or organization). Groups aggregate users for role assignment and license allocation. Requires the PM.Groups or PM.Groups.Read OAuth scope.

info.name: UiPath Get a Group by ID

params.name: organizationName
params.description: The name of the UiPath organization

params.name: partitionGlobalId
params.description: Global partition identifier for the organization or tenant scope

items.docs: Retrieves a specific user group by its unique identifier within the specified organizational partition. Returns group details including name, description, and member count. Requires the PM.Groups or PM.Groups.Read OAuth scope.

params.name: organizationName
params.description: The name of the UiPath organization

items.docs: Creates a new user group in the organization. Groups are used to assign roles in bulk, allocate licenses, and control access to automation resources. Members can be added after group creation. Requires the PM.Groups OAuth scope.
